sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: ABB: who is an entrepreneur
rows.value: Anyone who independently carries on a business or profession on the BES islands, or exploits an asset such as real estate for lasting income, is an entrepreneur for ABB, whatever the legal form and whether or not for profit; there is no small-business threshold on the Belastingdienst's ABB pages.

rows.label: Self-employed: combined income tax and premiums by assessment
rows.value: The self-employed pay the 29.4% / 38.4% income tax by assessment; the premiums AOV (25%), AWW (1.3%) and health insurance (0.5%) are part of that combined levy for those insured, on income up to the premium base.

rows.label: Director-shareholders: customary wage (gebruikelijk loon), standard amount
rows.note: a substantial-interest holder working for his company is deemed to earn the highest of 90% of the most comparable employment's wage, the best-paid other employee's wage (or 90% of net turnover) and this standard amount, unless a lower wage is shown to be customary.

rows.label: Contractors and commission workers: no employer premiums (ZV, OV, cessantia)
rows.value: Contractors of work (aannemers van werk) and their helpers, directors and supervisory directors, certain athletes and artists and people paid only on commission are within the wage tax but not insured for ZV, OV and cessantia: no employer premiums for those.

sections.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.

rows.note: a substantial-interest holder working for his company is deemed to earn the highest of 90% of the most comparable employment's wage, the best-paid other employee's wage (or 90% of net turnover) and this standard amount, unless a lower wage is shown to be customary.
rows.label: Director-shareholders: customary wage (gebruikelijk loon), standard amount

rows.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
rows.label: Contractors and commission workers: no employer premiums (ZV, OV, cessantia)
rows.value: Contractors of work (aannemers van werk) and their helpers, directors and supervisory directors, certain athletes and artists and people paid only on commission are within the wage tax but not insured for ZV, OV and cessantia: no employer premiums for those.
